intro: Hi, I'm Harry. This is my personal website.

whoAmI.title: Who AM I?
whoAmI.paragraph1: I'm Harry, with nearly 15 years' experience in Product Design and Front-end Development.
whoAmI.paragraph2: I work as a Product designer and Front-end engineer, and I'm also a Design Systems course instructor at AAPD — using Design System to build processes and component libraries that help design and engineering collaborate efficiently, shorten time-to-market, and accelerate validation.
whoAmI.paragraph3: I also founded and have operated awwrated, a streaming information platform, for 6 years — growing the user base by 300% and page views by 800%.

awards.title: Awards
awards.description: I have participated in multiple Website and Product designs and have received the following international awards for recognition.

clients.paragraph2: A Systems-driven approach that helps teams ship faster and improve consistency.

background.title: My design background
background.line1: My design inspiration didn't come from textbooks,
background.line2: but from the startup sound of the Famicom (NES).
background.line3:
Japanese culture of the 1980s, 8-bit pixels, tokusatsu, 
and anime taught me to tell stories with images.
background.line4: I once aimed to become a manga artist or game illustrator~
background.line5: Now I turn that obsession into a design methodology,
background.line6: building products that are more loved and more usable.

items.title: Ex-Shopmatic Co-Founder & Chief Product Officer
items.name: Kris
items.testimonial:
I have over six years of experience collaborating with Harry, including his tenure at the e-commerce software company I founded. Harry played a core role in product UI design and was responsible for final product refinement.
Harry not only possesses exceptional professional aesthetic sensibilities and can precisely capture and define a product's visual style, but his most unique value lies in his ability to serve as a perfect bridge between design and front-end engineering.
He can accurately understand technical constraints and requirements from an engineering perspective and deliver designs based on this foundation. This greatly enhances collaborative efficiency in the development process, ensuring the quality and precision of the final results. Harry demonstrates remarkable efficiency and refined professionalism that is extremely rare in cross-departmental collaboration.
With his combination of a designer's artistic vision and an engineer's logical thinking, Harry brings aesthetically pleasing and highly practical product solutions to any project. I wholeheartedly recommend Harry's professional capabilities.

items.title: Ex-Shopmatic Head of User Experience & Design
items.name: Darwin Ng
items.testimonial: I had the pleasure of working closely with Harry for around 7 years at Shopmatic. Harry consistently impressed me not only with his exceptional design skills but also with his proficiency in front-end development, bridging the gap between design and implementation seamlessly. He approaches projects with creativity, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset, making him a trusted partner on any team. I wholeheartedly recommend Harry for any design and development work.

items.title: Ex-Shopmatic Sr. Project Manager
items.name: Freddie Wynne
items.testimonial: I've had the pleasure of working with Harry both professionally and on private projects, and he consistently brings a fresh, unique design direction to everything he touches. His attention to detail is exceptional, and he has an intuitive understanding of the customer he's designing for - something that elevates his work far beyond the expected. Harry combines creativity with a deep sense of purpose, making collaboration with him both inspiring and fun.

items.title: Ex-Shopmatic Engineering Manager
items.name: Thenn Arasan
items.testimonial: I worked with Harry for several years at Shopmatic across my roles as Senior Software Engineer, Lead Engineer, and Engineering Manager. He was consistently one of the most dependable and impactful members of the team. Harry single-handedly created and maintained the Shopmatic Storybook, which became a core asset for our front end and engineering teams. His proactive updates, including aligning it with newer React versions, saved us significant time, improved consistency across UI, and made upgrades much smoother. He also contributed to key initiatives such as setting up Google Analytics, Facebook, and Clevertap events on our main landing pages at GoShopmatic.com, which strengthened our ability to track and understand user behavior. Harry combines strong design instincts and attention to detail with a calm, no-nonsense, high ownership mindset. He is friendly, collaborative, and always willing to help. I would be very happy to work with him again.

items.title: Co-founder, MacroMicro
items.name: Ken
items.testimonial: I've known Harry for over a decade. While we haven't worked side-by-side, I've consistently been impressed by his abilities. He possesses a sound and comprehensive understanding of modern frontend technologies, which he pairs with a genuine graphic design flare. It's a powerful and rare combination that allows him to create work that is both technically robust and visually compelling.

items.title: AAPD CEO & Canva Staff Designer
items.name: Simon Lin
items.testimonial: Working with Harry on our 'Design System Essentials' course was genuinely enjoyable and incredibly smooth. He brings a rare mix of design sense and frontend expertise, and that really showed throughout the project. Harry pays close attention to the details that matter, but he also thinks deeply about how to explain design system concepts in a way that feels clear, simple, and approachable for everyone—whether they're beginners or more advanced. What I appreciated most was his teaching mindset. Harry is always thinking about the learner's perspective, and he puts in the extra effort to provide helpful examples, resources, and materials that make the whole learning experience more complete. Whenever we ran into challenges, he offered thoughtful suggestions and practical solutions right away.

items.title: UXY.Design Founder
items.name: Yvon
items.testimonial: We've had the pleasure of collaborating with Harry on Design Systems workshop for UXY, and it's been a genuinely smooth experience. Harry brings real enthusiasm to his work. He's always quick to respond, humble in his approach, and genuinely curious about new tools and methods. Our participants praised how clearly he explains things, even when covering advanced topics.

items.title: KKDay Sr. Product Manager
items.name: Sherry Shih
items.testimonial: Working with Harry as a product manager has been an outstanding and genuinely enjoyable experience. He quickly understands product goals, user needs, and technical constraints, then turns them into clear, thoughtful designs for both app and web. His handoffs are always structured and easy for engineers to implement, which saves us a lot of time during development and reduces unnecessary back-and-forth. Harry combines strong visual design skills with a solid grasp of interaction patterns and responsive behavior across devices. His design files, specs, and components are well-organized and easy to navigate, which also benefits future iterations of the product. Harry is proactive, open to discussion, and consistently focused on improving the overall user experience rather than just making things look good. I would be very happy to work with him again and highly recommend him as a key design partner for any digital product team.

items.title: PayPay Product Designer
items.name: Ryan
items.testimonial:
Working with Harry during the AAPD Design System course was an invaluable experience. He has a remarkable ability to break down complex design system concepts into clear, structured insights, guiding students to understand not just the what, but the why behind each decision. His feedback is always insightful, practical, and rooted in deep expertise, helping learners connect theory with real-world application.
As a teaching assistant, I also benefited greatly from his perspective and teaching approach. Harry is an outstanding instructor and practitioner who truly inspires designers to approach design systems thoughtfully and strategically.

items.title: QNAP UX/UI Designer
items.name: Astrid Huang
items.testimonial:
After attending Harry's workshop by chance, I immediately invited him for an in-house training session. While there are many teaching articles and videos available, Harry is one of the few instructors who can approach the subject from both a 'designer + engineer' dual perspective.
The course progresses from fundamentals to advanced topics, covering Design System basics, implementation benefits, and practical creation. It's not just theory—he shares hands-on experience from zero to one, completely transforming our understanding of Design Components logic. Combined with AI tool applications, the content is so substantial that one day simply isn't enough! Highly recommended for those who need intensive communication with frontend teams, or designers who want to better understand frontend engineers' perspectives.

contact.title: CONTACT
contact.subtitle: Have a design or development need? If you're looking for a partner with 15 years in product design, development, and operations, drop me a line — or challenge me to an 8-bit game!
